summary: Manual audit replay harness request and sample credibility pack for SIEM ingestion validation
description:
Issue summary:
Customer requests a one-time manual replay harness and a small 'credibility pack' of signed sample events to validate ingestion and mapping in their SIEM ahead of a scheduled regulator review. They want field-level provenance and a short playbook describing how to re-run the replay locally and verify signatures.

Impact:
- NimbusHealth requires demonstrable evidence that Redwood audit events can be ingested, deduplicated, and mapped to their internal schema before 2026-03-20 regulatory review.
- Blocker for their compliance sign-off; they asked for signed examples and a replay run to be done with customer participation.

Environment:
- Customer prod tenant: tenant-nimbushealth-7
- Region: us-east-1
- Expected export path: s3://redwood-nimbushealth-exports/2026/03/

Requested deliverables:
1) A zipped credibility pack (max 200 events) containing: canonical JSON events, field provenance manifest (CSV), per-event SHA256 sigs, and a signed manifest file.
2) A scripted manual replay harness (bash + docker compose) and step-by-step playbook for the customer to run against a sandbox Splunk HEC endpoint.
3) A one-hour live session with Support/Platform to run the replay and confirm ingestion and field mapping.

Steps Support used to reproduce / validate locally:
1) Recreated export job for tenant-nimbushealth-7 for 2026-03-12 window.
2) Run export->archive flow to local staging s3 mock.
3) Started replay-service in local dev mode and piped events to a Splunk HEC test endpoint.
4) Verified signatures via signing-service using customer's public-key material provided via secure upload.

Logs / sample event (sanitized):
- 2026-03-12T18:04:22.123Z | tenant:tenant-nimbushealth-7 | event_id:evt-8a5b | action:generate_response | model:open-llama-3-20b | checksum:sha256:3f2a...
- 2026-03-12T18:04:22.456Z | event_id:evt-8a5b | signature:SIG_BASE64_EXAMPLE_TRUNCATED

Notes on customer constraints:
- Customer cannot accept PII in sample events; requested redaction for user identifiers but needs mapping table that shows redaction was applied.
- Customer requires HMAC over manifest with key rotation evidence (last rotation 2026-02-28).
steps_to_reproduce: Recreate tenant export for 2026-03-12 window using export-runner --tenant tenant-nimbushealth-7
Push exported JSON to local s3mock bucket and run replay-service --input s3://local/mock/2026-03-12
Verify Splunk HEC receives events and field mappings are present
Validate per-event signatures with signing-service verify --key customer_pub.pem --manifest signed-manifest.json
logs: [INFO] replay-service: connected to splunk-hec http://localhost:8088 - batch 50
[DEBUG] signing-service: event evt-8a5b signature verified, sha256 match
comments: 2026-03-13 10:12 - Asha Patel (Support): Opened request after customer asked for demonstrable artifacts ahead of their audit. Asked for customer's public key and sandbox HEC URL.
2026-03-13 13:45 - NimbusHealth (Customer): Uploaded public key and provided HEC token via secure upload. Requests replay window 2026-03-12 to 2026-03-12T23:59.
2026-03-13 16:03 - Marcus Nguyen (Platform): Created initial credibility pack (50 events) and uploaded to secure share. Flagged two events with PII that were redacted — provided mapping table.

2026-03-14 09:10 - Elena Ruiz (SRE): Ran manual replay to customer sandbox HEC during scheduled window. Splunk ingestion confirmed; 2 events deduplicated by HEC — reason: identical event_id after customer's dedupe rule. Logged note for follow-up to add nonce to export manifest.
2026-03-14 11:30 - Asha Patel (Support): Scheduled 1-hour live session with NimbusHealth for 2026-03-15 15:00 UTC and attached playbook and zipped credibility pack.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: customer needed both signed examples and a reproducible playbook; low risk to prod since we operate with a copy of export data.
Found two sample events containing user.email in free-text; redaction applied and documented in provenance CSV.
Deduplication seen at customer HEC due to event_id namespace collision; recommended adding an export nonce per-run to manifest and file naming.
resolution_notes: Provided zipped credibility pack: nimbus_cred_pack_2026-03-14.zip (50 events, signed_manifest.json, provenance.csv, readme.md).
Delivered manual replay harness repo link and one-click docker composition for local run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/replay-harness/tree/SUP-601432

Performed live replay to customer sandbox HEC with customer present; confirmed ingestion and field mapping. Two events marked deduplicated by HEC — customer to adjust dedupe rule or accept nonce recommendation.
Follow-ups: (1) Create small export change to add run_nonce to manifest (INT-4421), (2) Offer signed monthly credibility packs as a paid add-on (CS ops follow-up).
